flags: Cache identifies the National Scenic Byway by name but supplies no designation date or road-building campaign. History paragraph distinguishes earlier regional travel from the modern route.

Driving order is west to east to match material mileposts: Celina, York farm at Pall Mall, Rugby. Current moments reversed without changing titles, coordinates or motifs. Material’s Block entry has an inconsistent final placement/mile value and is not used.

The byway route narrative is attributed to Edwin Gardner, who died in 2010, and predates Rugby’s December 2013 bypass. Avoided precise current turns and did not claim TN 52 still runs through the village.
York source contradicts itself about Gracie donating versus selling the farm to Tennessee. Omitted the acquisition transaction. Farm gift and later mill purchase are distinguished.
No current claims dropped for lack of cache support; replaced the dismissive idle-second-sons wording and preserved initially/early scope for York’s rejection of commercial offers.
Broad route sequence is supported, but the cache supplies no current access notices or whole-route travel time.
